notes: v2.5.45. Customer portal: customers sign in with an authenticator, see previews of everything they send (CATIA included), raise and answer flags, and approve restructured packages item by item; a portal intake view inside AOS. eBOM: a Release timeline (Timeline, Time machine, Rev map) with event layers and Recover, deleted rows come back, custom step groups, steps cascade down assemblies, History on every row, release emails always arrive, pictures always current. Routers and travelers: templates update routers, a router change keeps the floor travelers, Replace traveler, clearer publish drawer. 3D: saved models rebuild on their own, saved views, view a model together, part bodies, a fully worded toolbar. CNC card v2 with phase lights and a faster board. Badge PINs, one scanner for the whole app, notification settings, and access by role everywhere.
